This criminal revision case has been preferred against the summon issued in CC.No.476 of 2024 on the file of the Judicial Magistrate, Additional Mahila Court, Tiruppur dated 24.12.2024.
2.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate, Additional Mahila Court, Tiruppur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner is now arrayed as A5 in the aforementioned case.

Initially the second respondent lodged complaint and the same was registered against five persons including the petitioner in crime No.13 of 2024 for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 312, 294(b), 323 & 506(i) of IPC.
After completion of investigation, the first respondent filed final report excluding the name of the petitioner.

However, during the cross examination of all the witnesses, there are specific allegations against the petitioner and as such under Section 319 of Cr.P.C, the petitioner has been added as and accused summons was issued.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 11/09/2025 04:38:29 pm )

3. The learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that even according to the evidence of PW1,
all the allegations against the petitioner are only through phone and no ingredients are available to attract the any of the offences.
4. Per contra, the learned counsel for the second respondent would submit that not only based on the second respondent's deposition and also others have spoken about the specific overt act of the petitioner to attract all the charges.
5. Heard, the learned counsel appearing on either side and perused, all the materials placed before this Court.
6. On perusal of records, it is revealed that there are specific allegations against the petitioner.
Therefore, the trial court rightly added the petitioner as an accused and this Court finds no infirmity or illegality in impleading the petitioner as an accused and issuance of summons to him.

As such,
this criminal revision case fails and the same is liable to be https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis (
Uploaded on: 11/09/2025 04:38:29 pm ) dismissed.
7.
Accordingly, this criminal revision case is dismissed.
However, the personal appearance of the petitioner is dispensed with and she shall be represented by a counsel after filing appropriate application.
